title: Depression Isn't a Chemical Imbalance — It's a Prediction Error
description:
For sixty years we called depression a chemical imbalance. But that explanation was built backwards from the drugs, not measured in the brain. Newer neuroscience tells a different story: depression may be what happens when the brain stops predicting that effort will be repaid with reward.

This video walks through the predictive-brain view — interoception, allostatic regulation, and the inflamed body that quietly rewrites your forecast of the future. Not sadness. An energy budget drawn by a brain that no longer expects the world to pay it back.

This video is for education only and is not medical advice. If you are struggling, please reach out to a qualified professional or a local crisis line.
